title: Grim Reaper on Pier
description: A skeletal Grim Reaper in a purple robe stands on a wooden pier over colorful swirling water, holding a bloody handgun in one hand and a large ornate clock in the other. The surreal sky features a blue dragon, a scythe-wielding grim reaper silhouette, a green skeleton elephant on a broomstick, multiple hot air balloons, and traditional East Asian buildings floating in the water below.
prompt: A skeletal Grim Reaper wearing a flowing purple robe stands on a wooden pier over swirling colorful water, holding a handgun with red blood dripping from it in one hand and a large ornate green and gold clock in the other. In the chaotic sky above, a large blue and orange dragon flies, a green skeleton elephant rides a broomstick, multiple hot air balloons float, and a large grim reaper silhouette with a scythe looms in the clouds. Traditional East Asian pagoda-style buildings float in the water, with vibrant colors, swirling patterns and a dreamlike surreal atmosphere.
